ideas.pitch: An AML-style risk detection and fraud mitigation platform for local agricultural cooperatives in New Chandigarh, combining graph intelligence and LightGBM to trace supply chain bottlenecks and payment leaks.
ideas.title: Punjab Agri-Supply Chain Graph Risk Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy localized context relevant to regional judges and mirrors the high-complexity engineering pattern seen in Bito, focusing on graph-based risk identification.

ideas.pitch: Automated satellite imagery monitoring tool tailored for local industrial development corporations to track unauthorized land use changes and zoning violations in real-time.
ideas.title: Industrial Land Compliance Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles industrial and regional governance pain points with a concrete utility that appeals heavily to local institutional judges.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace that ingests real civic problems submitted by local communities and automatically matches them with verified student developer teams using decentralized escrow milestones.
ideas.title: Local Community Problem-Solution Autonomous Matchmaker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly embodies the core tagline of the hackathon—bridging real problems and solutions—while demonstrating sophisticated multi-agent orchestration.

ideas.pitch: A Poisson regression and GAM-powered forecasting tool designed for local municipal authorities to predict urban utility failures and emergency response incidents with calibrated 90% prediction intervals.
ideas.title: Regional AI Incident & Resource Forecasting Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely rigorous statistical modeling and predictive analytics, matching the technical depth of the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust-building platform tailored for independent healthcare clinics in New Chandigarh to manage community outreach, intake, and transparent trust metrics.
ideas.title: Trust Engine for Local Health Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a polished, production-ready product for a clear local business vertical, mirroring the rapid utility delivery seen in the Global-Smile win.
